notes.title: Big update is coming with 1.1.0
notes.notes:
- Revamped menu interface for smoother navigation
- Added the brand-new Adventure Mode
- New boss introduced in Adventure Mode
- Minor performance optimizations
- 15 new Steam achievements, with a permanent bonus granted every 5 unlocked
- New spell: "Glitch", temporarily disables enemy functionality
- Improved passive descriptions, now clearly displaying the stats they grant
- You can now select upgrades using the same keys as your spells
- Lasers now have a maximum length limit
- New passive: "Cooldown Reduction", shortens spell cooldowns
- New effect: "Enemy Orb Wipe", destroys all enemy orbs currently in the level
- Fixed enemy overlap issues
- Reduced enemy group sizes to avoid near-impossible scenarios
- Passive and spell upgrade progress is now displayed

Thank you for testing the game, feel free to give me any feedback or report any bug to Glow Journey Discord
